messages:
Maya Patel: quick thread  we need a concrete spec for routing safeguards + multi-region isolation so PM/Sales can price features. high-level yes/no decisions only here.
Ajay Singh: agree. key decision: "shared fabric + guards" vs "virtualized fabric" for near-term.
Nora Chen: compliance checklist: data residency (region pin), auditable routing decisions, and exportable request-level logs. any solution must expose those.
Maya Patel: propose three primitives to standardize: 1) tenant_affinity (soft), 2) tenant_quarantine (evac+isolate), 3) tenant_fence (dedicated). map to pricing tiers.
Samir Rao: infra POV: implement tenant_affinity and quarantine on current fabric with QoS + cache quotas. tenant_fence needs separate pool + networking namespaces.
Leah Ortiz: ops ask: runbook must include automated evac, a warm standby in alternate region, and "last-mile" routing failover. Sales needs the list to commit SLAs.
Ajay Singh: rollout gating: dev -> internal beta (opt-in customers) -> canary 0.1%/1%/5% -> GA. telemetry gating: token p50/p95/p99 and error rate delta.
Nora Chen: customer constraints: some will insist on tenant_fence by contract. let's make default = shared with an opt-in fence clause and pricing delta.
Maya Patel: launch acceptance criteria (minimum): documented failure modes + mitigations, two pilot customers on Tier 1, per-tenant latency & cost telemetry, and an evacuation playbook validated by drills.
Samir Rao: technical blocker: current KV cache is global. short term patch = per-tenant cache quota + eviction priority. need experiment to pick default quota (128MB? 256MB?).
Ajay Singh: propose default cache_quota = 256MB for Tier1, perf test targets: <10% tail latency increase for others when one tenant blasts cache.
Leah Ortiz: monitoring needs: per-tenant dashboards, alerts for quota breach, and an "isolation_health" endpoint for canary gating. Ops can run warm failovers with that.
Maya Patel: policy + API sketch (proto):
```
routing_policy: tenant_affinity
isolation_tier: Tier1
cache_quota_mb: 256
bandwidth_limit_mbps: 50
evac_policy: auto_on_quota_breach
failover_preference: regional
```
Ajay Singh: looks good. add: fallback_model_variant and audit_export_destination.
Nora Chen: legal/compliance redlines: audit logs retention default 90 days, exportable in JSONL, and region-lock enforcement must be contractual.
Samir Rao: action items: I will run cache-thrash sims and post numbers by Wed.
Maya Patel: I'll draft the short spec and pricing bullets by Thursday EOD. Leah will draft runbook template. Nora will collect compliance redlines and list customers needing fence.
Leah Ortiz: ack. I'll also schedule an evac drill with infra on next sprint.
Ajay Singh: ack. I'll produce a rough price uplift model for tenant_fence options.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: started canary job "safeguards-routing-v1" at 4890012500.
Maya Patel: thanks all  keep any customer-specific exceptions in this thread so spec can absorb them.
